summary.name: imgcook
summary.one_liner: Imgcook (图像大厨) is an Alibaba/Taobao intelligent tool that converts design files into code, with output for multiple frameworks.
use_cases: turn UI designs into front-end code
speed up frontend development from design files
export design layers to react or vue components
integrate generated code into an R&D pipeline
use custom components in design-to-code output
summary.what_it_does: Imgcook takes designs exported from design tools (via plugin) or uploaded design files in its online editor and generates front-end code from them. The page says it supports 4 design types and officially provides 10 DSLs, including react, rax, Vue and applet, with custom DSLs possible. Generated code is described as having reasonable DOM nesting, relative positioning and semantic class names. Additional tools include a CLI for integrating output into local projects, a VS Code editor plugin, and custom plugins for post-processing exported code. It also offers an open material system for using a team's own component library.
notable: Supports 10 officially provided code output DSLs including react, rax, Vue and applet
Has a CLI, a VS Code editor plugin, and custom plugins for post-processing code
Open material system for custom component libraries
Reported 79.34% code retention rate after going online in Tmall's 2019 Double Eleven activity
caveats: Page notes GitHub login instability and suggests switching to DingTalk login
Page does not state pricing explicitly; listing tags it as free
